name: Intermediate Chirography
oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
When this Class enters, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
{1}{B}: Level 2
Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
{2}{B}: Level 3
At the beginning of each end step, if a modified creature died under your control this turn, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each end step, if a modified creature died under your control this turn, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.

needs.what: a turn-ledger value or condition counting creatures that died this turn under a given player's control, filtered by their last-known state -- here 'modified' (had counters, an attached Equipment, or an Aura its controller controlled) at the moment it died -- usable as an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `creatures_died_this_turn` takes only a player spec and counts every creature death with no filter; the `modified` selector key reads live permanents on the battlefield, not dead ones; writing an unprinted `dies` trigger that sets a turn flag would be an approximation the brief forbids (and it would miss deaths before the Class reached level 3 -- which the printed ledger condition counts)
